_comment: What is monitored on chain and under which terms. Read by relayer/ (devices, bookings) and soteria-frontend/ (sensor panels, thresholds). Only wagons listed here carry a sensor; general goods carry none. Penalty, deadline and liability cap come from data/contracts/<contract>.json.
_comment_timing: Demo timings are compressed: a real grace period is minutes, a real standstill slack hours. Temperatures and pressures are realistic; the rate at which a failed unit warms is accelerated (see relayer/src/physics.ts).
